news.title: Lending protocol Bonzo loses 77% of value locked as $9 million oracle exploit rattles Hedera
news.summary: Bonzo Lend lost approximately $9.05 million after an attacker exploited a verification flaw in a third-party Supra oracle contract on the Hedera network.

news.title: Crypto IPO market stalls as capital rotates to AI and macro uncertainty weighs
